nodes.label: Figma is the Single Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: figma is the single source of truth
nodes.rationale: Values must never be estimated visually; pause if Dev Mode info is unavailable.

nodes.label: Figma as Engineering Specification
nodes.rationale: Figma is treated like API documentation: translate, do not reinterpret.

nodes.label: Avoid !important
nodes.rationale: !important signals specificity or architecture problems.

nodes.label: Token Categories (color, type, spacing, radius, shadow, motion, opacity)
nodes.norm_label: token categories (color, type, spacing, radius, shadow, motion, opacity)

nodes.label: Component Lifecycle (identify, check, extend, create, validate, reuse)
nodes.norm_label: component lifecycle (identify, check, extend, create, validate, reuse)

nodes.label: Wrapper-Based Styling for Rich Text
nodes.rationale: CMS will not reliably preserve custom classes, so style via wrapper selectors.

nodes.label: Reuse Before Creating
nodes.rationale: Existing project architecture takes precedence over new structures.

nodes.label: CMS CTA Fields reuse shared button
nodes.norm_label: cms cta fields reuse shared button

nodes.label: Decorative Icons via ::before/::after
nodes.rationale: Editors may delete inline markup and sanitizers may strip it.

nodes.label: Separation of Structure, Presentation, Behaviour
nodes.rationale: HTML defines meaning, CSS appearance, JavaScript behaviour.

nodes.label: HTML Ownership (CMS owns content, frontend owns presentation)
nodes.norm_label: html ownership (cms owns content, frontend owns presentation)

nodes.label: AI Instruction Priority Order
nodes.rationale: AI is an implementation assistant, not the architect; user > handbook > project architecture > Figma > framework conventions > AI preferences.

nodes.label: Client boundaries: no use client on sections
nodes.norm_label: client boundaries: no use client on sections
nodes.rationale: Server components keep pages fast with minimal client JS; only interactive leaves are client components.

nodes.label: Recompile SASS on compiled-CSS merge conflicts
nodes.norm_label: recompile sass on compiled-css merge conflicts

nodes.label: Route to Controller to Blade page pattern
nodes.norm_label: route to controller to blade page pattern

nodes.label: Per-usage suffixed class for repeated sliders
nodes.norm_label: per-usage suffixed class for repeated sliders

nodes.label: Figma Fidelity Floor (1280px)
nodes.rationale: Visual fidelity to Figma must hold from frame width down to 1280px on every stack; only below 1280px may layout reorganize.

nodes.label: Golden Rule: component CSS in 3-modules not 5-pages
nodes.norm_label: golden rule: component css in 3-modules not 5-pages
nodes.rationale: pages.sass only compiles each page's own partial, so a component styled there renders unstyled on any second page.

nodes.label: Two Bundle Strategy (app.css + pages.css)
nodes.rationale: Smaller initial downloads and better caching, since shared styles change less often.

nodes.label: Lazy-load below fold, never hero media
nodes.norm_label: lazy-load below fold, never hero media

nodes.label: Senior Engineer Mindset / Engineering Culture
nodes.rationale: Consistency is more valuable than individual coding preferences.

nodes.label: Slider Behaviour Validation
nodes.rationale: Library defaults must never be assumed to match the approved design; every behaviour (autoplay, drag, loop, pagination) is explicitly verified.

nodes.label: Final QA Release Gate
nodes.rationale: Final QA is an approval process confirming earlier validations, not a debugging phase.

nodes.label: Delivery Workflow (Impl > Browser QA > Figma > Final QA > Approval)
nodes.norm_label: delivery workflow (impl > browser qa > figma > final qa > approval)

nodes.label: Keep noindex, nofollow policy
nodes.rationale: noindex is never removed to chase a score; the 'blocked from indexing' audit is the only accepted SEO failure.

nodes.label: Browser QA Workflow (launch, screenshots, compare, fix)
nodes.norm_label: browser qa workflow (launch, screenshots, compare, fix)
nodes.rationale: QA is continuous, not end-of-project, so defects are fixed immediately rather than accumulating.

nodes.label: No 'close enough' acceptance rule
nodes.rationale: Figma is the single source of truth; approximations are not acceptable.

nodes.label: pageWrapper (scoped page class)
nodes.rationale: Scopes page CSS and JS, prevents CSS leakage and component conflicts.

nodes.label: Shared Layout Pattern (main, header, pageWrapper, footer)
nodes.norm_label: shared layout pattern (main, header, pagewrapper, footer)

nodes.label: PHP as Page Assembly Engine
nodes.rationale: PHP is not the application layer; it only composes reusable frontend components.

nodes.label: Navigation Types (primary, secondary, mobile, footer, utility, breadcrumb)
nodes.norm_label: navigation types (primary, secondary, mobile, footer, utility, breadcrumb)

nodes.norm_label: shared navigation javascript (toggle, dropdown, scroll state)
